snippets.en: And it came to pass that after many days it began to put forth somewhat a little, young and tender branches; but behold, the main top thereof began to perish.
snippets.tr: E aconteceu que, passados muitos dias, começaram a brotar ramos pequenos, novos e tenros; mas eis que sua copa começou a morrer.
